test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 14 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following sentences uses the word "rose" with the **same meaning** as in the following sentence?

"He gave her a single red rose on their anniversary"

options.text: The water level rose quickly after the heavy rain.
The smell of the freshly cut rose filled the room.
Prices for gasoline rose sharply over the weekend.
The sun rose just as we were finishing our hike.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"rose"** in the provided sentence refers to a type of flower, specifically a red rose. (गुलाब)
 
 
• **Example:** He gave her a bouquet of roses for her birthday.
 
 
• In Option 2, the word "rose" is used with the same meaning, referring to a flower. (गुलाब)
 
 
• **Example:** The smell of the freshly cut rose filled the room.
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
